# Yu Luo (罗宇) — Nankai University

Yu Luo (罗宇) is a PhD student at Nankai University working on LLM agents and AIOps: multi-agent systems for incident management and failure diagnosis, abductive reasoning, and agent memory.

- Personal site: https://luoyu100.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/luoyu100
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=GK-Oor4AAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-8708-1187
